title: Time Converter
description:
**Goal:** Convert a raw number of seconds into days/hours/minutes/seconds.
```
Enter seconds: 200000
200000 seconds = 2 days, 7 hours, 33 minutes, 20 seconds
```
hints: `/` answers "how many whole days fit?" and `%` answers "how many seconds are left over?". Do the same with 3600 for hours, then 60 for minutes.
stretch: reverse it — read d h m s and print total seconds.
